scoring_justification: Maximum relative difference between with-ee and no-ee curves is recomputed from the agent's CSV data; steady-state drift velocity is compared against a paper-reported value.

hidden_assets.purpose: Steady-state drift velocity reference value for n-GaAs at 5 kV/cm, 300 K, n=1e18 cm⁻³
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Estimated from the solid curve of Figure 3 in the paper (new EMC with e-e, which coincides with conventional EMC without e-e). The plateau value is approximately 1×10⁷ cm/s.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual reading of published figure; approximate value used with a generous 10% tolerance to absorb estimation uncertainty and implementation variance.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from the paper's own reported result; the value is the physical saturation velocity of electrons in GaAs under those conditions, consistent with known literature.

outputs.description: Time evolution of drift velocity for the two simulation types. The checker will compare the two curves and the steady‑state value.
Time evolution of electron temperature for the two simulation types. The checker will compare the two curves.
Time evolution of Γ and L valley fractional populations for the two simulation types. The checker will compare the two sets of curves.

output_contract.notes: The three CSV files contain time-series data produced by the Monte Carlo simulations. They are scored by recomputing the maximum relative difference between the with‑ee and no‑ee curves and by checking the absolute steady‑state drift velocity against a hidden reference. No gold values are visible in this contract.
